title: Israel's president picks Gadi Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form the next government
caption:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog has tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government after 67 of 120 lawmakers recommended him, against 46 for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The formal mandate is handed over on Sunday. Eisenkot then has 28 days, with a possible 14-day extension, to build a coalition of at least 61 seats.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
